布.meaning: With one <part>slash</part> of her scissors and <part>one</part> straight cut, a tailor trims a <part>towel</part>-sized piece from a roll. Smooth, cool and a little crinkly, it isn't cotton at all. It's fine <kanji>linen</kanji>.
布.on: She sews the linen into a crisp cover for a <sound>fu</sound>ton.
布.kun: She keeps the cloth in a reading <sound>noo</sound>k, and when the cat climbs on it she shouts '<sound>No</sound>!'

役.meaning: A <part>maiden</part> runs the <part>chairlift</part> on the mountain: she checks every bar, waves every skier on, and brushes the snow off every seat. Rain or shine, she never leaves her post. It's her <kanji>duty</kanji>.
役.on: Her other job is watering a spiky <sound>yuc</sound>ca at the top of the lift.

示.meaning: A tour guide climbs onto a crate made of <part>two</part> planks and holds up a <part>little</part> sign on a stick. 'Look over there!' she points. 'And there! And there!' Her whole job is to <kanji>show</kanji> you things.
示.on: She drives the group around in a muddy <sound>jee</sound>p, pointing out of the window.
示.kun: In the castle she points to a knight's <sound>shi</sound>eld, then to a <sound>me</sound>dal in a glass case.

禁.meaning: Deep in a <part>grove</part> stands an old stone <part>altar</part>, and a sign nailed to a tree says KEEP OUT. No picnics, no climbing, no touching. Anyone who steps closer breaks the <kanji>prohibition</kanji>.
禁.on: Only a <sound>kin</sound>gfisher ignores the sign and perches right on the altar.

衣.meaning: A <part>lid</part> on top like a collar, and below it the cloth swings open and flares out at the hem. Hang it on a hook, slip your arms in, tie the belt. It's a <kanji>garment</kanji>.
衣.on: As you put it on, an <sound>ee</sound>l wriggles out of the sleeve.
衣.kun: A <sound>ko</sound>ala sews a robe for a <sound>ro</sound>dent out of an old <sound>mo</sound>ccasin.

表.meaning: A tailor stitches <part>two</part> stripes and a <part>pole</part> of buttons onto the outside of a <part>garment</part>. The rough seams stay hidden inside, and only the neat side faces the world. That's its <kanji>surface</kanji>.
表.on: A dancer in one tall <sound>hee</sound>l spins a <sound>yo</sound>-yo across the shiny surface.
表.kun: '<sound>Oh</sound>!' you spot a muddy <sound>mo</sound>ccasin print on the outside of your <sound>te</sound>nt.
